fields.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
fields.summary: An epic open world western from Rockstar Games. Play as Arthur Morgan, an outlaw navigating the decline of the Wild West.
fields.notes: One of the most cinematic games ever made. Take your time with it.

fields.name: Hollow Knight
fields.summary: A challenging 2D action-adventure set in a vast underground kingdom of insects. Beautiful hand-drawn art and deep lore.
fields.notes: Incredibly polished indie game. Silksong cannot come soon enough.

fields.name: The Godfather
fields.summary: Francis Ford Coppola's 1972 crime epic following the Corleone family as Michael reluctantly takes over his father's crime empire.
fields.notes: Widely considered the greatest film ever made. Watch all three.

fields.name: Pulp Fiction
fields.summary: Quentin Tarantino's 1994 crime anthology weaving together multiple interconnected stories of crime and redemption in Los Angeles.
fields.notes: Non-linear storytelling at its best. Every scene is iconic.

fields.name: The Wire
fields.summary: An HBO crime drama following the Baltimore drug trade from the perspectives of both law enforcement and drug dealers. Often called the greatest TV show ever made.
fields.notes: Slow start but worth every minute. Each season focuses on a different institution.

fields.name: Succession
fields.summary: HBO drama following the Roy family as they fight for control of their global media empire. Sharp writing and complex characters throughout.
fields.notes: Gets better every season. The finale is perfect.
